<thought>We need to create an ML‑ready tabular dataset from the polymorph JSON using the advanced feature engineering, 20% test split, and normalization. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will generate the training and test files plus a metadata JSON inside the specified output directory. After running it, we will list the output directory to find the metadata file and return its path.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_6/polymorph_data.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_6/nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
